name.en-US: On the Recognition of One's Own Frailty

description.la: Libellus de recognitione propriae fragilitatis: cognitio sui, humilitas, vanitas mundi, divina misericordia.
description.en-US: Eight chapters on knowing one's own weakness, humility, the vanity of the world and trust in God's mercy. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Oito capítulos sobre o conhecimento da própria fraqueza, a humildade, a vaidade do mundo e a confiança na misericórdia de Deus.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis De recognitione propriae fragilitatis, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia II; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: Pohl's text without his critical apparatus and introduction; line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script, upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Raw OCR: drop capitals at openings are often garbled and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.
